article.title: Penalty for violation of safety measures for motor cycle drivers and pillion riders.
article.content:
194CPenalty for violation of safety measures for motor cycle drivers and pillion riders.

Section 194C  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 107 of the Act
Whoever drives a motor cycle or causes or allows a motor cycle to be driven in contravention of the provisions of section 128 or the rules or regulations made thereunder shall be 4[liable for a penalty] of one thousand rupees and he shall be disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.
4 Subs. by Act 8 of 2026, s. 2 and Sch. for “punishable with a fine” (w.e.f. 15-8-2026).
